ad_placement_lesson:
2026-09-01: save_post rejected unclaimed list_ad_offers with 'can not accept any more opportunities' — the ad account has a concurrent-acceptance cap. Prefer embedding already-ACCEPTED, in-window opportunities from list_ad_opportunities(status=accepted) whose send_by is after the target send timestamp; those embed without re-accepting. Ad node:
(omit kind to let the server pick a creative). Publication default theme is LIGHT, so apply save_post_theme per-post (background_color/content_background_color #222222, paragraph_color + h*_font_color #FFFFFF, inline_link_color #7DD3FC) to get the dark AI Current look.

established_template.description: AI Current dark theme. Each block wrapped in a node-section div with data-background-color #222222 and data-color #FFFFFF, padding 20. Cover image is a 16:9 imageBlock figure with 30px rounded corners. Story sections use h2 headings (Models & Research, Industry & Business). Sign-off + Share button at the end. Sponsor slots use advertisementOpportunity nodes labeled 'A word from our sponsor' only when offers/agreements exist.
